propositions: A related-material pin matching a supported historical fingerprint generation of current material is incorrectly classified as stale-pin-drift because derive_health compares only against the latest fingerprint without compatibility checking.

The prerequisite material did not change, but the fingerprint algorithm evolved between post-330c/pre-2be7 and current, causing a signed historical pin (6b113a084820af9d) to mismatch the latest generation (bbe91c054a677441).

The fix must extend derive_health with a narrowly scoped compatibility predicate that accepts a pin only if recomputing current related-ticket material under a supported historical full-fingerprint generation exactly matches the signed pin.
Genuine unmatched hashes and pins with no matching historical generation must remain classified as stale-pin-drift after the fix.
Own-ticket attestation already applies _legacy_material_ok compatibility checking; related-pin health was the only missing parallel surface and must adopt the same supported-generation rule.
